name: @btkulka/image-library
description: A library of images, videos and 3D models on disk in one SQLite file: nested virtual collections, tags, search (words, tags, model, dates), watched folders that file new images by themselves, gemini-image's prompt and cost sidecars, moving and renaming files with their sidecars, picks, view counts, ffprobe's facts and an ffmpeg frame for videos (through media-kit), and the Benhäus panel's carousel lines. Works on a node:sqlite DatabaseSync the app hands in; grid thumbnails through Electron's nativeImage, also handed in.
